tools.name: calculate_car_tax
tools.description: Calculate annual UK vehicle tax (VED / road tax) for a car. Handles all three UK systems: cars first registered before 1 March 2001 (taxed on engine size, so engine_size_cc is required), 1 March 2001 to 31 March 2017 (CO2 bands £20–£790, so co2 is required), and from 1 April 2017 (flat standard rate

tools.name: check_clean_air_zone
tools.description: Check whether a car is compliant with UK clean air zones (London ULEZ, Bristol, Birmingham) and what it would cost to drive into them. Returns compliance, the daily charge per zone, and estimated annual cost. Only 3 of the 8 English charging zones charge private cars; Scotland uses Low Emission Zone

tools.name: check_mot_due_date
tools.description: Work out when a car's MOT test is due, and the earliest date it can be tested without losing its renewal date. These are Great Britain (DVSA) rules: a car's first MOT falls on the third anniversary of registration, then annually. Northern Ireland is tested by the DVA, where the first test is not due

tools.name: mot_outlook
tools.description: Odds that a used car passes its next MOT first time, for its age and mileage, counted from DVSA's own MOT test records with odometer readings (Great Britain) — and how those odds move one mileage band lower or higher for a car of the same age. tools.name: get_model_reliability
tools.description: Get known common faults, best and worst model years, and real DVSA MOT first-time pass rates for a specific used car model in the UK.
